svg.title: Reference system wiring
svg.desc: Actual Victron SmartSolar MPPT 75/15 photograph with six separate wires: BATT positive and negative to a battery, PV negative and positive to a panel, LOAD negative and positive to a USB-C converter. External fuses are shown in both positive battery and load branches.

g.text: F1: battery fuse near battery +. F2: load-branch fuse. Select protection and wire sizes for the actual build.
